## API

Everything below is imported from `@nanahoshi/mona-ui/toolbar`. Each name links to its reference page, with every input, output, property and method.

| Name | Kind | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [`ToolbarComponent`](/api/toolbar/ToolbarComponent) | Component | A row of controls, such as formatting buttons, that's one Tab stop: the arrow keys move between its controls. |
| [`ToolbarItemDirective`](/api/toolbar/ToolbarItemDirective) | Directive | Marks a control directly inside `<mona-toolbar>` as one that moves into the toolbar's More menu when there's no room for it, last ones first. |

### Types

| Type | Kind | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [`TOOLBAR_DEFAULT_MESSAGES`](/api/toolbar/TOOLBAR_DEFAULT_MESSAGES) | Constant |  |
| [`ToolbarItemOverflow`](/api/toolbar/ToolbarItemOverflow) | Type alias | Whether a toolbar item moves into the More menu when there's no room for it (`auto`) or stays (`never`). |
| [`ToolbarOverflow`](/api/toolbar/ToolbarOverflow) | Type alias | What a toolbar does with items that don't fit: moves them into a More menu, or wraps them onto more rows. |

**Related types:** [`ClassInputType`](/api/common/ClassInputType), [`MonaToolbarMessages`](/api/i18n/MonaToolbarMessages), [`PreventableEvent`](/api/common/PreventableEvent)
